name: Thiethylperazine
summary: Thiethylperazine (Torecan, Norzine) is an antiemetic of the phenothiazine class. It is an antagonist of dopamine receptors (DRD1, DRD2, DRD4) as well as of 5-HT2A, 5-HT2C receptors, mAChRs (1 through 5), α1 adrenergic receptor and H1 receptor.

pharmacology.text: It is an antagonist of dopamine receptors (DRD1, DRD2, DRD4) as well as of 5-HT2A, 5-HT2C receptors, mAChRs (1 through 5), α1 adrenergic receptor and H1 receptor. Thiethylperazine activates the transport protein ABCC1 that clears beta-amyloid from brains of mice.

uses.en: It was used to prevent and treat nausea and vomiting, including after surgery, under names such as Torecan and Norzine.
uses.zh: 它曾以Torecan、Norzine等名稱用於預防及治療噁心與嘔吐，包括手術後的噁心嘔吐。
uses.zhHans: 它曾以Torecan、Norzine等名称用于预防及治疗恶心与呕吐，包括手术后的恶心呕吐。

sideEffects.en: Like other phenothiazines, it can cause drowsiness, dry mouth, dizziness and movement problems such as muscle spasms and restlessness, and rarely neuroleptic malignant syndrome, a dangerous reaction with fever and rigid muscles.
sideEffects.zh: 與其他吩噻嗪類藥物一樣，它可能造成嗜睡、口乾、頭暈，以及肌肉痙攣、坐立不安等運動問題，少數情況下可能出現抗精神病藥物惡性症候群，這是一種伴隨發燒與肌肉僵直的危險反應。
sideEffects.zhHans: 与其他吩噻嗪类药物一样，它可能造成嗜睡、口干、头晕，以及肌肉痉挛、坐立不安等运动问题，少数情况下可能出现抗精神病药物恶性症候群，这是一种伴随发烧与肌肉僵直的危险反应。

fact.en: Thiethylperazine is a phenothiazine anti-sickness drug. In mice it was found to switch on a pump protein that clears beta-amyloid, the protein that builds up in Alzheimer's disease.
fact.zh: 硫乙拉嗪是一種吩噻嗪類止吐藥。在小鼠實驗中，研究人員發現它能活化一種負責清除β類澱粉蛋白的幫浦蛋白，而β類澱粉蛋白正是阿茲海默症中會堆積的蛋白質。
fact.zhHans: 硫乙拉嗪是一种吩噻嗪类止吐药。在小鼠实验中，研究人员发现它能活化一种负责清除β类淀粉蛋白的帮浦蛋白，而β类淀粉蛋白正是阿兹海默症中会堆积的蛋白质。
